q1.prompt: Jobs must finish in the order they arrived. Which structure matches that order?

wrong_lifo.explanation: FIFO needs a queue. A stack (LIFO) serves the newest item first, which breaks arrival order for BFS and fair job processing.

q2.prompt: Which workload does not fit FIFO?

choices.label: When the newest item must be handled first, or front removal is an O(n) shift at scale
Never — always reach for a queue when order matters

wrong_refuse.prompt: Blind FIFO is not always right.
wrong_refuse.explanation: Avoid a queue when the newest item must be handled first (use a stack). Avoid implementing front removal as an O(n) shift when constant-time dequeue is required. Avoid BFS with a stack — that is DFS.

success.prompt: You matched FIFO to queues and recognized when LIFO or a deque fits better.
